title: The irrationality exponent of pi is 2
summary: We prove the conjecture that the irrationality exponent of π is 2. As a consequence, the classical Flint–Hills series $`\sum_{n\ge1}1/(n^3\sin^2 n)`$ converges, with angles in radians.
family_title: The irrationality exponent of π is 2

review.reason: Proves the irrationality exponent of pi equals 2, with consequences for the Flint–Hills series.
